beginner.title: Your First Prompt
beginner.description: Write a clear, specific prompt asking ChatGPT to explain a concept you're curious about.
beginner.instructions: Choose any topic and craft a prompt that includes: what you want explained, how detailed the explanation should be, and any specific examples you'd like.

beginner.title: Fix the Vague Prompt
beginner.description: Improve a poorly written prompt by adding specificity and structure.
beginner.instructions: Given prompt: 'Tell me about dogs'. Rewrite it to be specific, clear, and likely to produce useful results.
beginner.exampleSolution: Explain the top 5 dog breeds suitable for apartment living, including their temperament, exercise needs, and typical size. Format as a numbered list with brief descriptions.

beginner.title: Context is King
beginner.description: Practice adding context to make prompts more effective.
beginner.instructions: Write three versions of a prompt asking for recipe suggestions: 1) No context, 2) Some context, 3) Rich context. Compare the difference.

intermediate.title: RTFC Framework Practice
intermediate.description: Apply the RTFC (Role, Task, Format, Constraints) framework to create a professional prompt.
intermediate.instructions: Create a complete RTFC prompt for: generating social media content for a new coffee shop opening. Include all four elements explicitly.

intermediate.title: Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
intermediate.description: Write a prompt that uses chain-of-thought to solve a complex problem.
intermediate.instructions: Create a prompt that asks ChatGPT to solve a multi-step business problem using explicit reasoning steps.

intermediate.title: Few-Shot Learning
intermediate.description: Provide examples to teach ChatGPT a specific output pattern.
intermediate.instructions: Create a few-shot prompt with 3 examples that teach ChatGPT to transform product features into benefit-focused bullet points.

intermediate.title: Prompt Battle
intermediate.description: Create two different prompts for the same task and compare results.
intermediate.instructions: Write two prompts asking for blog post ideas: Version A uses direct instruction, Version B uses role-playing. Test both and analyze which works better.
successCriteria: Both prompts aim for same goal

intermediate.title: Constraint Challenge
intermediate.description: Practice using constraints to shape outputs.
intermediate.instructions: Write a prompt with at least 5 different types of constraints (length, tone, format, audience, style) for creating an email.

expert.title: Build an API Wrapper
expert.description: Write Python code that wraps the OpenAI API with custom error handling and retry logic.
expert.instructions: Create a Python class that handles API calls, implements exponential backoff, caches responses, and logs all interactions.

expert.title: Token Optimization Challenge
expert.description: Reduce a verbose prompt by 50% while maintaining effectiveness.
expert.instructions: Take a 500-token prompt and rewrite it to use only 250 tokens. Test both versions and compare quality of outputs.

expert.title: Workflow Pipeline
expert.description: Design a multi-stage prompt workflow for a complex task.
expert.instructions: Create a 5-stage workflow for generating market research reports: 1) Research, 2) Analysis, 3) Synthesis, 4) Formatting, 5) Review. Provide prompts for each stage.

expert.title: Custom GPT Configuration
expert.description: Design a complete Custom GPT for a specific professional use case.
expert.instructions: Create full configuration for a Custom GPT that serves as a code review assistant. Include instructions, conversation starters, and capabilities.

expert.title: Production Content Pipeline
expert.description: Build a complete automated content generation system.
expert.instructions: Implement the full content pipeline from the course: outline → draft → SEO optimize → generate images → final review. Make it production-ready with error handling and logging.

safetyScenarios.scenario: Sharing your work email and password to get help organizing your inbox
safetyScenarios.explanation: Never share passwords or sensitive credentials with AI systems. They could be exposed or misused.

safetyScenarios.scenario: Asking ChatGPT to help you understand a medical diagnosis your doctor gave you
safetyScenarios.explanation: It's OK to seek understanding, but always verify medical information with healthcare professionals. Don't use it for diagnosis.

safetyScenarios.scenario: Having ChatGPT write your entire college essay and submitting it as your own work
safetyScenarios.explanation: This violates academic integrity. Use AI as a learning tool and writing assistant, not to generate work you claim as your own.

safetyScenarios.scenario: Asking for help understanding a programming concept for your class
safetyScenarios.explanation: Using AI to learn and understand concepts is great! Just make sure you actually understand the material.

safetyScenarios.scenario: Pasting your company's confidential strategy document to get a summary
safetyScenarios.explanation: Don't share confidential, proprietary, or sensitive business information. It could be stored or leaked.
